game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · General-purpose languages
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Echo Chamber.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 4: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about General-purpose languages.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Infinite Loop Trap' (Week 4 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Echo Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

source_player_objective: Protect the crystal door from skeleton miners in Echo Chamber: keep the loop_safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Echo Chamber Defense
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
